payout_quote: Javara 'Clinical Trials Near You' hub: We are currently enrolling for the following studies below... You may be compensated for your time and travel. Albany, GA - Congestive Heart Failure Study: Compensation: Up to $1,800; Treatment Resistant Depressive Disorder Study: Compensation: Up to $1025; Influenza Vaccine Study: Compensation: Up to $325; Hypothyroidism Study: Compensation: Up to $975; Obesity/Weight Loss Study: Compensation: Up to $1850; Type 2 Diabetes - GLP-1 Study: Compensation: Up to $2016. Endometriosis study page: Compensation up to $2,325 may be provided for time and participation. COPD Study 05: Compensation for your time and participation up to $560 may be provided.
steps: Open Javara's official 'Clinical Trials Near You' hub (javararesearch.com) and pick a currently-enrolling study matching your condition and location (e.g. Type 2 Diabetes GLP-1 study in Albany, GA: 18-75, diagnosed T2D, stable metformin dose, no GLP-1 in last 6 months).
Complete the Interest Form for that study; Javara's team will contact you.
Pass the medical screening and meet the study qualifications (not everyone qualifies).
Complete the study visits; some sponsors reimburse travel and Javara partners with Uber Health for prepaid transportation to visits.
Receive the study compensation (up to $2,016 for the T2D GLP-1 study) for your time and travel.
catches: Studies target specific patient populations (type 2 diabetes, congestive heart failure, COPD, hypothyroidism, obesity, endometriosis, treatment-resistant depression); you must pass medical screening, and not everyone qualifies.
The $2,016 is an 'up to' ceiling for completing the study; amounts vary by study ($325-$2,325 across listed studies).
You may receive an investigational study medication or placebo with real medical risks and side effects.
Multi-visit, months-long commitment; compensation is tied to completing visits, not paid upfront.
Study availability varies by location and changes over time; confirm current enrollment with Javara.
The official listing does not state the exact visit schedule or visit count, so the total time above is an estimate — the actual time commitment could be higher.
biggest_catch: You must qualify for and complete a specific patient-population study (e.g. type 2 diabetes) over multiple visits spanning months; the $2,016 is an 'up to' ceiling for full completion, and you may receive an investigational study drug with real side-effect risks.
eligibility: Study-specific patient criteria (e.g. T2D GLP-1: 18-75, diagnosed T2D, A1C over 7, stable metformin, no GLP-1 in 6 months); must pass medical screening.
timing: Compensation for time and travel is paid for participating in the study; travel reimbursed for completed visits; confirm payout schedule with the study team.
